title: SAMA pathway scribe output
description: What the pathway scribe returns for one Finnish clinical-style note. Two formats share one envelope. 'absolute': the model writes ISO dates itself (the dataset-v1 target). 'expression': the model copies the date wording from the note and serve/client.py does the calendar arithmetic. Send one of the two sub-schemas under $defs to the server for guided decoding; do not send this whole document. Research artefact trained on synthetic text only; not for clinical use.

x-sama.enumSource: scribe/sample.py ROUTES, TYPES, MONTHS (serve/tests/test_schema.py fails if they drift)
guidedDecodingNotes: Keywords used: type, properties, required, additionalProperties:false, enum, pattern, items, maxItems. None of them is on the reject list of has_xgrammar_unsupported_json_features in vLLM v0.29.0.
pattern is never combined with minLength or maxLength: vLLM v0.29.0 rejects that combination for the xgrammar backend because xgrammar drops the length bound silently.
Patterns use only literals, character classes, alternation, plain groups and bounded repetition, so they mean the same in Python re and in Rust-style regex engines.
Property order equals the key order of the training targets (entry_route, events; type, date, precision).
A pattern cannot check the calendar (31.2. passes) or that MONTH precision uses day 01. serve/client.py checks those after decoding and sends failures to human review.
